name: switch__apple_write_unsupported
description: Apple ships an IM:WriteRequestMessage targeting an OnOff cluster on an endpoint with no Switch cluster server (empty wbEmptySnapshotter topology). The bridge MUST still reply with a WriteResponse on the same exchange — silent drops or panics break Apple's MTRDevice write timer and cause UI hangs. The scenario locks 'WriteRequest always elicits a WriteResponse' regardless of whether the dispatcher could resolve the path; failure status codes live inside the response, not in its absence.
